name: Solutions Map
purpose: A visual aid to map the impact of capabilities to the top of mind initiatives of key stakeholders.
whereUsed: The Solutions Map is best used in the Problem Space during the Analysis Phase (2.3) to “Illustrate Innovative Solutions”. It’s also useful in the Solu- tion Space to demonstrate integration points of solutions.
why: We will demonstrate the tangible worth of a set of capabilities (solution) by illustrating how those capabilities relate to business priorities.
outcomes: Understanding of how a set of capabilities (solution) contribute to personal, professional and business priorities for stakeholders
Confirmation that a complete set of integrated, innovative capabilities addresses multiple priorities for the business

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Explain and confirm an understanding for a set of integrated capabilities
Map and agree to the impact of the capabilities to address “top of mind” initiatives
Determine gaps in capabilities to fully address business priorities

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Highlight how a solution fits into an enterprise-wide set of integrated capabilities
Demonstrate the synergies to be gained by bringing multiple capabilities together
Demonstrate how capabilities close gaps created by business problems
